title: Manual-auth post-signup navigation fix + Jobseeker Profile Setup (Fresher/Experienced with experiences)

requirements.summary: Eliminate the post-signup infinite loader by making route protection/profile-completeness checks non-blocking under manual auth and allowing /profile-setup to render immediately.
acceptanceCriteria: After a successful signup on the Signup page, the app navigates to /profile-setup and renders the Profile Setup form (not an indefinite loader).

If the Profile Setup page cannot determine profile completeness (e.g., because a backend profile fetch is unauthorized/unavailable), the UI must not block with an infinite spinner; it should fall back to the manual-auth stored state for completeness checks and allow profile setup.
Protected routes (jobseeker/employer) must not get stuck rendering only a loading indicator due to profile completeness checks.

file_operations.description: Remove the redirect/loader loop by (1) allowing the /profile-setup route to render even when the backend profile query is loading/failed, and (2) using manual-auth persisted profile-completion state as the primary/fallback signal for completeness checks when backend profile fetch is unavailable/unauthorized. Ensure no code path returns an indefinite loader for jobseeker/employer routes.

Adjust the profile query hook return shape to expose non-blocking states (e.g., distinguish 'actor not ready', 'fetch failed/unauthorized', and 'success') so ProtectedRoute can safely fall back to manual-auth completion without spinner loops. Keep all user-facing text in English.

Ensure the post-signup navigation to /profile-setup cannot be obstructed by loading state (e.g., clear any stale errors/loading flags promptly) and that the button/loading state returns correctly; rely on the fixed ProtectedRoute behavior so the form is interactable immediately. Keep all user-facing text in English.

requirements.summary: Implement the Jobseeker Profile Setup UI for Name/Mobile/Email/Location plus Fresher vs Experienced, with up to 5 add/edit/remove experience entries and English validation.
acceptanceCriteria: Profile Setup for role=jobseeker displays inputs for Name, Mobile Number, Email ID, Current Location, and an Experience Status dropdown with exactly two options: Fresher and Experienced.
When Experience Status = Fresher, the experience-entry UI is hidden and no experience entries are required.
When Experience Status = Experienced, the experience-entry UI is shown and the user can add up to 5 entries; attempting to add a 6th entry is prevented with clear English validation messaging.

Each experience entry contains fields: Company Name, Designation, Process, Last Salary, and Duration (with an explicit months/years choice or a clearly labeled single duration input that captures months or years).
The submit button remains disabled while saving, and validation errors are shown in English when required fields are missing.

file_operations.description: Replace the current jobseeker form with the specified fields: Name, Mobile Number, Email ID (prefill from manual-auth session and render as read-only or clearly labeled), Current Location, and an Experience Status dropdown with exactly 'Fresher' and 'Experienced'. When 'Experienced' is selected, render a repeatable experiences section with add/edit/remove controls capped at 5 entries and English validation (including a clear message when trying to add a 6th). Each entry must include Company Name, Designation, Process, Last Salary, and Duration with an explicit months/years choice. Use existing shadcn-ui components (e.g., Card, Button, Input, Label, Textarea, Select, Alert) to compose the UI; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Extend/augment local TypeScript types used by manual auth and profile setup as needed to represent the jobseeker profile setup payload in the UI (including experience status and up to 5 experience items). Keep all user-facing text in English.

requirements.summary: Persist manual-auth profile completion so users are routed to the correct next page after Profile Setup and are not redirected back to /profile-setup on refresh or subsequent visits.
acceptanceCriteria: On successful Profile Setup submit, the app navigates to /jobseeker/dashboard for jobseekers and /employer/candidates for employers.
Manual-auth stored account/session state is updated to indicate the profile is complete (so ProtectedRoute no longer redirects the user back to /profile-setup).
Refreshing the browser after completing profile does not send the user back to /profile-setup (unless they explicitly clear storage/log out).

file_operations.description: Add manual-auth APIs/state to persist and retrieve profile completion per stored account (e.g., a context value like hasCompletedProfile and an action like markProfileComplete()). Ensure it updates localStorage-backed account state so refreshes preserve completion and ProtectedRoute can use it reliably. Keep all user-facing text in English.

On successful submit, mark the manual-auth account as profile-complete and navigate to the correct route based on role (/jobseeker/dashboard or /employer/candidates). If saving a backend profile is unavailable/unauthorized, still treat local completion as success for routing and future access. Disable the submit button while saving and show English errors when validation fails. Use existing shadcn-ui components for alerts/buttons; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Update profile-completeness gating/redirect logic to use the manual-auth persisted completion flag so users who completed setup are not redirected back to /profile-setup on subsequent visits/refresh. Ensure jobseeker/employer protected routes render without getting stuck on a loading indicator.

Ensure routing after login uses the persisted manual-auth profile completion state (so completed users go directly to /jobseeker/dashboard or /employer/candidates and are not sent back to /profile-setup). Keep all user-facing text in English.
